notes: Body checks status selector 0x13, clears/preserves the second argument based on low-byte status, applies index and object checks, then tail-calls an unresolved helper with a value loaded from object+0x258. The evidence does not establish that this is an attribute-selector dispatch, so the proposed name overstates semantics. Indexed caller f_7000aad4a4 calls it with an indexed value at decompiled/main/main_0055.c:10414-10416.

Gate-byte path calls accepted validate_and_populate_attribute_record_candidate; true result performs key 0xd06 lookup and follow-up calls, returns 1, and clears gate byte on both paths. Caller populate_rtts_combine_attribute_summary supports contextual attribute-record scope. No proposed offset/field claims.

Accepted read_pem_private_key call is followed by two helpers; when the first helper yields a nonzero result and input pointer is nonnull, the routine passes input[0] to another helper and stores the first result back to input[0], then returns it. The description of the store as a helper result is behaviorally accurate, though helper semantics are unresolved. Callers are present in crypto paths; indexed behavior lists two caller addresses.

Body dispatches through object+0x1c0, resets global state slots, conditionally allocates and stores a resource; caller is inside initialize_frontend_dialog_audio_state. “Frontend state” is supported by caller context, while exact purpose of global slots remains unresolved.

After a gate check, calculates contextual value twice; compares zero (left operand) to returned float (right operand) and returns 0 when CC_LE, 1 otherwise. For finite values this returns 1 for negative values, not positive. Caller invokes it during compute_player_attribute_metrics.
